script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let v be each x in arg mapped to the value "no" of x.
Let v2 be the first x in v where x is 1.
If v2, then
  For each part in the parts of the enemy, finish off part.
  Return true.
Otherwise
  If the length of call helper3 with (the enemy) is the length of list and the length of arg is 1, then set (the register of this state)'s 'turnCountSinceEitherAlignementDied' to 0.
  Return true.

Given arg.
Let hpRate be the HP fraction of arg.
Let v be the value "paramId" of arg.
Let v2 be v → to-string → substr with (the length of v → to-string minus 1).
Let v3 be _ → index-of with (each x in list2 mapped to x's 'paramSuffixNo', v2).
Let hpRate2 be the phase for arg under the phases list2 with HP fraction hpRate from phase v3.
Let paramIdBySuffixNo be the stat block of form list2 at hpRate2's 'paramSuffixNo' on arg.
If paramIdBySuffixNo is not v, then
  Arg changes to stat block paramIdBySuffixNo.
  Arg cancels its cast.

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let globalRegister be the register of arg's 'parent'.
If globalRegister's 'turnCountSinceEitherAlignementDied' is set, then
  Let executer be the acting enemy of arg.
  Let aiArg be the battle settings of executer.
  Part 1 of executer.
  Increase globalRegister's 'turnCountSinceEitherAlignementDied' by one.
  If globalRegister's 'turnCountSinceEitherAlignementDied' is at least the numeric entry "turns_of_cant_summon_since_either_alignement_died" in aiArg, then set globalRegister's 'turnCountSinceEitherAlignementDied' to nothing.

Let aiArg be the battle settings of executer.

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let executer be the acting enemy of arg.
Let part be part 1 of executer.
Let v be call helper3 with (executer).
Let ability be the id of the move labelled "summon_alignement" on part.
Let ability2 be the id of the move labelled "drain" on part.
Let withoutAbilityList be the excluded moves of part with options {forceIgnoresReflection: false}.
If call helper4 with (arg), then
  If the length of v is 0, then append ability2 to withoutAbilityList.
Otherwise, append ability to withoutAbilityList.
Part → lot-and-register-ability-without with (withoutAbilityList).
